## Virtual screening and applicability domain

The FDA library funnel, the similarity domain with its threshold sensitivity, the conformal interval, and the candidates with their efficiency metrics.

`screening_variables.tex`, written by `05_virtual_screening.py`. Regenerate with `python run_pipeline.py --only 05`. It reads the output of step(s) 04, so regenerating one of those means regenerating this family too. Step(s) 05.1 read what it writes, so refresh those after it.
